rules.name: unicode_normalization
rules.description: Ensures precomposed Vietnamese vowels and tone diacritics are standard NFC form.

rules.name: case_folding
rules.description: Lowercases all text, harmonizing uppercase prompts (VIVOS) and mixed-case transcripts (ViMD).

rules.name: punctuation_stripping
rules.description: Removes all punctuation marks while preserving all Vietnamese accented characters and alphanumeric tokens.

rules.name: whitespace_collapsing
rules.description: Collapses multiple spaces, tabs, and newlines into a single space and strips boundary whitespace.

application: Identical deterministic normalization applied to both reference and hypothesis before WER and CER calculation.
